Metadata.title: Bible Inspiration Chat
Metadata.description: Find spiritual encouragement and guidance through Scripture

Welcome.heading: Welcome
Welcome.description: Share what's on your heart, ask questions about Scripture, or simply seek encouragement. While I can help explore theological topics, I'm not a substitute for trained theologians or pastoral guidance.
Welcome.prompt1: I'm feeling anxious about the future
Welcome.prompt2: What does the Bible say about forgiveness?

Chat.disclaimer: AI-generated responses may contain errors. Not a substitute for theology or pastoral counsel.
